conclusions: The app principal can create a marked sandbox Request and receive a server-assigned request number when GoVerify is bypassed.
The synchronous Copy Applicant to Payee workflow completed far enough to populate the payee with the Foundation account; it was not independently proven broken by the earlier rollback.
No payment, regarding email, Foundation account mutation, or Foundation child Contact mutation was observed.
The marker, run ID, fiscal year, request type, and both false reminder flags survived create readback.
The requested meeting date did not survive create processing and requires workflow or platform-owner explanation before a deterministic recipe can rely on it.

No Dynamics SharePoint document location appeared. Disabled sandbox background processing prevents this rehearsal from validating the expected asynchronous document/folder workflow, but does not by itself identify the location provisioner.
